verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant inside a backend platform's console is a fair thing to ask for, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows external-agent tooling: an MCP server for Claude Code and Cursor, agent Skills, docs as Markdown, and llms.txt. It also shows AI building blocks for apps, such as embeddings and image labeling. None of this is a first-party in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to.
